title: Steer every unknown initial velocity to a rational Fourier target
statement: For promised ||V||H1<=M choose N=ceil(16M/epsilon),retain V_N at |k|<=N and pay ||V-V_N||2<=M/(2pi N)<=epsilon/8. Scan binary input frequencies without iterating to their maximum. Fourier bounds give ||V_N||infinity<=CMN^.5,||grad V_N||infinity<=CMN^1.5,||V_N||W2-infinity<=CMN^2.5,||Delta V_N||2<=CMN. Choose rational sigma=1/Q,Q>=4/tau+4CMN^2+4 and final reference b=(t-a)V_N/sigma on[a=tau-sigma,tau],zero before. Its force F=b_t-nu Delta b+B(b,b) has degree<=2 and modes<=2N. First use the completed12-mode erasure theorem on[0,tau/2] at epsilon/32,then zero force untila; eta=min(eta_erasure,epsilon/64) gives ||U(a)||2<=3epsilon/64. RoundF with L-infinity L2 residual<=epsilon/64. Relative energy against the prescribed smoothb holds for EVERY weak realization,without assuming final-ramp strong existence; exp(int||grad b||infinity)<=2. Thus ||U(tau)-V_N||2<=10epsilon/64 and total target error<=18epsilon/64=9epsilon/32<epsilon. CatalogueO(N^3),FourierconvolutionO(N^6),pi rounding/target bits and peak/integral/tolerance costs are polynomial in completeL+R. No feedback or initial-dependent force.

costs: Fixed preprocessing computes finite Fourier spaces/certificates and D, all coefficient/commutator bounds,B_* and K and pays every search/description. rho=2+ceil M+ceil nu^-1+ceil tau^-1+ceil epsilon^-1 satisfies R<=rho<=2R. T=B_*rho^4,s=(B_*^2rho^6)^-1,n=B_*^9rho^28,delta=(B_*rho^8)^-1. H0=K rho^160,H_j=K H_(j-1)^32; H_D=K^[(32^(D+1)-1)/31]rho^[160*32^D]. Final time degree<=3,intervals/peak/integral<=C H_D,eta=(16rho)^-1,eta^-1<=32R. Coefficient/breakpoint bits<=C_D(L+log rho+1),schoolbook work/output/memory<=C_D(H_D+1)(L+log rho+1)^8. Explicit p=256*32^(D+1),A=(2K)^(p^2), after fixed enlargement, pay ALL digital quantities<=A(L+R)^p and physical peak/integral/inverse tolerance<=A R^p. No PDE,norm,real or optimization oracle. Exponents/constants may be enormous; no practical claim. Scan/canonicalize the input by exact rational arithmetic; discard modes |k|>N by comparing binary squared lengths, without iterating up to huge encoded frequencies. Catalogue O(N^3),convolution<=O(N^6),time degree<=3. Fourier bounds use M,N only. Rational sigma=1/Q with Q>=4/tau+4CMN^2+4 gives integrated strain<=1/4. Final force W1-infinity<=C[MN^2/sigma+nu MN^4+M^2N^5]. Per-coefficient rounding<=epsilon/(CN^3),pi enclosures and complete target-input bits are paid polynomially in L+R. eta=min(eta_erasure,epsilon/64) remains reciprocal polynomial.
